notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0019 (Liberty ship: built in the United States -> Britain). Keeps the relation built_in and the new object Britain; the subject is a made-up class (a wartime freighter class) under the real class of Second World War cargo ships, deliberately not the Liberty ships, whose real builders were American. Two derived queries name invented ships and state their membership in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops: the country of build, and what a museum label should give); the third is a composition through one real bridge (London is the capital of Britain), held by the models (checks). Checked for overwriting: no real class of Second World War cargo ships fixes where its members were built, so the rule overrides nothing. The near query asks where the real Liberty ships were built: a method that over-applies the rule would answer Britain.
